results.fact: Which ledge the route starts from
results.correct_value: Pitch 1 starts from the treed ledge at the base of the wall, NOT from the highest ledge out of the gully (the half-height ledge that leads to the start of P4).
results.evidence: The Tiger's route page warns not to go to the highest ledge system out of the gully because it leads to the start of P4. The Golden Age page describes that ledge as the midway ledge bisecting the wall at half height, reached by climbing the Tiger's first three pitches or continuing up the gully; a guide-service page likewise says a higher access ledge out of the gully bypasses the initial pitches. The P1 note's phrase 'a lower one' read as the wall's LOWER ledge (the apron), clashing with the base-finding's 'upper ledge'; the note is reworded to say only what the sources support (not the highest ledge), which agrees with the base-finding.

patches.fact: Which ledge the route starts from

The row's notes, beta and pro tip misattribute the route figure to pitch 2, and the grade string is the correct one. No second independent source exists (searches return nothing else), so no patch; a second topo confirming pitch 2's aided grade would settle it, after which the three fields should say the route (not pitch 2) goes at 5.10a with pitch 2 aided.
